easy-song.title: Choose a song
body: Drop a track, or press Bundled demo.
This step does not start a picture.

easy-vibe.title: Pick a vibe
body: Choose a card, and type an idea in one line if you have one.
The line can name things, a theme, a place or a feel; the cut follows it.

easy-make.title: Make the prototype
body: Make renders a quick Draft: a long song becomes 30 s around the drop, in minutes.
On its screen you refine it on the timeline, re-cut it with the knobs, then render the whole song or Final.
easy-make.sim: Simulated. No GPU job was started. The bundled demo stands in.

weights.title: Open weights
body: The default path is local open weights: Z-Image Turbo for stills, LTX 0.9.5 for Draft morphs and LTX-2.5 (LTX-2.3 where it is not installed) for Final morphs.
Add-ons stay off. The badge reads Open weights and links to the licence page.

easy-macros.title: Turn the knobs
body: Intensity, Speed, Chaos and Glow set how hard the cut hits; the Look chips set its colour.
Fine-tune under them holds the rest: length, aspect, the Model (Draft, Fast Final, Final, Cloud Final), your images and the chain; Polly and the rest wait in Work in progress.

tours.name: The desk in a minute
tours.blurb: A song, a vibe, the knobs, then a prototype.
